أتفاجأ (form VI)
# أَتَفَاجَأُ (ʔatafājaʔu) /ʔa.ta.faː.d͡ʒa.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَفَاجَأَ (tafājaʔa)
# أَتَفَاجَأَ (ʔatafājaʔa) /ʔa.ta.faː.d͡ʒa.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَفَاجَأَ (tafājaʔa)
# أَتَفَاجَأْ (ʔatafājaʔ) /ʔa.ta.faː.d͡ʒaʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَفَاجَأَ (tafājaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
